chapter.verse: Amaute Jerusalem khuapi tawh kinai Oliv Mualah a om Bethfage khua leh Bethani khua-ah a tun’ uh ciangin, Zeisu in a nungzuite nih sawl a,
“Na mai uh ah a om khua-ah pai un la; tua khua-ah na lut uh ciangin kuama tuan’ ngei lohna lano khat khau khihsa a, om thakhatin na mu ding uh hi. Lano khau sut un la, ka kiangah hong paipih ta un.
Mi khatpeuh in, ‘Bang hangin hih bangin hih na hi uh hiam?” hong cih leh,‘Topa in a deih hi,’ ci le uhteh amau in thakhatin hong khah ding hi,” ci-in a vaikhak hi.
Amaute pai uh a, lampi ah inn kongkhak mai-ah lano khat kikhihsa a muh uh ciangin a khau a sut uh hi.
Tua san takah a ding kimkhatte in, “Bang hangin la khau sut na hi uh hiam?” a cih uh ciangin,
Zeisu in a vaikhak bangin a gen uh a, tua mite in a khah uh hi.
Amaute in lano Zeisu kiangah paipih uh a, a tungah amau puante a phah khit uh ciangin Topa a tuangsak uh hi.
Mi tampite in lampi ah amau puante a phah uh hi. Adangte in lo lai-ah singhiangte satin a phah uh hi.
A mai pai, a nung a zuite in, “Hosanna! Pasian’ min tawh hong paipa in thupha ngah ta hen!
A hong piang ding i pa David’ Gam in thupha ngah ta hen! Van a sang belna-ah Hosanna!” ci-in a kiko uh hi.
Jerusalem khua biakna innpi sungah Zeisu lut a, na khempeuh a kawivel khit ciangin, nitum ahih manin Sawm-le-nihte tawh Bethani khua-ah a pai uh hi.
Zing ciangin Bethani khua pan a paikhiat lai takin Zeisu a gilkial hi.
Teh a nei theikung a gamla pan mu a, tua kung tungah gah a mu kha ding hi, ci-in va pai a, a tun’ ciangin a teh longal bangmah a mu kei hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, a gah hun ahi kei hi.
Zeisu in, “Tu-a kipanin na gah kuamah in ne kik nawn kei ta hen,” a ci hi. A nungzuite in zong hih thu a za uh hi.
Jerusalem khua-ah Zeisu a tun’ ciangin biakna innpi sungah lut a, biakna innpi sunga sumzuakte leh sum leite khempeuh hawlkhia a, dangka kheekte’ sabuaite leh vakhu zuakte’ tutphahte sawnthal sak a;
biakna innpi sungah beel khat nangawn, kuamah in a paipih loh nadingin a kham hi.
“Ka inn in mipawl khempeuhte thungetna inn a kici ding hi,’ ci-in Lai Siangtho sungah kigelh hilo ahi hiam? Ahih hangin note in tua inn guta buluhte omna na piangsak tazen uh hi,” ci-in a hilh hi.

Siampi liante leh laitheite in a zak uh ciangin, Zeisu thah nading thu a zong uh hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, mihonpite khempeuh in Zeisu’ thuhilhna lamdangsa mahmah uh ahih ciangin, amaute in amah a kihta uh hi.
Nitak simin Zeisu in khua nawl ah a paikhia hi.
A zing ciangin lampi ah a pai lai takun, theikung a zung pan akipan na dinggaw a om a mu uh hi.
Piter in phawk a, “Rabbi aw, na samsiat theikung a dinggaw zo hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Zeisu in, “Pasian na um un.

Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, mi khatpeuh mah in a lungsim sungah um khial lo a, ama cih bangin piang ding, ci-in a up leh, hih mual kiangah, ‘Na omna pan na khinkhia in la, tuipi sung kiden’na in,’ a cih leh, a cih mah bangin a piang ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, ke’n kong cih-inah thu ngen a, na nget khempeuh uh ngah ding cih na up uh leh, na ngah ding uh hi.
Note ding-in thu na nget uh ciangin, midang peuhmah tungah lungkim lohna na neih uh leh;
vantungah a om na Pa un note’ mawhnate hong maisak theih nadingin ama mawhnate na maisak un,” a ci hi.
Amaute khatvei Jerusalem khua ah a tun’ kik uh ciangin, Zeisu in biakna innpi tual ah a kawivak lai takin, siampi liante, laitheite leh upate a kiangah hong pai uh a,
“Hih nate kua thu tawh bawl na hi hiam? Hih nate bawl nadingin kua in thu hong pia hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Note ke’n zong kam khat kong dong ding hi. Na hong dawn’ theih uh leh, hih nate kua thu tawh ka bawl, kong hilh ding hi.
Johan baptaizna thu in vantung pan hong piang ahi hiam, mi tung pan hong piang ahi hiam hong dawng un,” ci-in a dong hi.
“Vantung pan hong piang hi,’ ci leeng, ‘Note in ama thu bang hangin um lo na hi uh hiam?’ ci-in hong dong zel ding hi.
‘Mi tung pan hong piang,’ ci leeng mite i kihta hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, mi khempeuh in Johan pen kamsangpa a sa uh hi,” ci-in khat leh khat a kikum uh hi.
“Ka thei kei uh hi,” ci-a a gen uh ciangin Zeisu in zong, “Tua mah bangin hih nate kua thu tawh ka bawl kong gen kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
